title: Hanasato Minori — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What do I do? What do I do...?
I'm still too scared to go in...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eeep!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka...!
G-Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What are you doing...?
People are going to start thinking you're up to no good if you keep hovering outside the classroom like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But...
But! But! But!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Our class...!
It's so sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sparkly?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, look!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The girl in front of the blackboard! That's Kaepon, right?! The “uou-uo” model!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that other girl by the window looks like Akari, the fitness streamer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And lastly, I'm standing right next to the legendary idol, Haruka Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This class is basically a gathering of the galaxy's biggest superstars! Is someone like me even allowed to go in?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been like two weeks since we were placed in this class, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, two weeks isn't nearly enough time for me to get acclimated! I still have to squint because your auras are all so brilliant!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not to mention, aside from everyone working in show business, we have pro gamers and classmates who've started their own businesses.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's what I mean! They're so grown up and their auras scream, “I'm a big success!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, some do give off that impression.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's go inside.
We really shouldn't keep talking while blocking everyone's way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Haruka, wait for me!
Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(This is why Haruka's so amazing...!
She's able to just nonchalantly greet people who appear online or in magazines...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(*Sob*
While I'm yet to make any new friends... And it's been two whole weeks already...!)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Oh, who's that behind you? Hanasato...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Y-You can see me...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're not a ghost.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But I pretty much am since I have no presence compared to everybody else...!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Haha. You're pretty funny, Hanasato.
I've actually been meaning to talk to you for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?! W-With me...?

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
I've sorta been wondering what you're like in real life after seeing your guys' streams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you know who I am...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Of course!
You're Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: You're the only one out of your group who's never been an idol before, but you've been working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
I'm also actually a huge idol fan.
I have all the big names on my radar, but also a lot of the smaller groups.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line: I began following MORE MORE JUMP! a little bit after you began doing those livestreams, and I've really been rooting for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You have...?!

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to act like a fan there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, that's totally fine...
If anything, I feel incredibly honored to receive such high praise from THE Kaepon!

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line: Haha. You don't have to call me THE anything. Just Kaepon's fine.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Anyway, it's so incredible how famous MMJ has become. I mean, Hinomori returning to TV after such a long absence was big news by itself.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Everyone in the biz has been talking about you girls since around the time of your solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's actually a bit of a relief since it's coming from someone in the industry.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: After all, we need to catch all the waves we can.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna catch a big one too.
If we ever end up working together, please share some of your luck with me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Us? Working together...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Oh, I can definitely see that happening!
More importantly, I'm really glad we got to talk and become friends today.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: So, Kiritani, Hanasato, let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Yes, let's all do our very best!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been jumping back and forth between speaking formally and not.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're all the same age, so let's keep things friendly between us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... O-Okay!
Then, if neither of you mind, I'll try being...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, wait. You're showering me with all this praise, but I see you two all the time on the internet and in magazines and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Haha. There's the Hanasato I'm used to seeing online.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we managed to break the ice. Oh, while we're on the subject, we should totally go somewhere together when we're all free! There's this place right by the station that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you, Minori...
